name: Shadelope
look: a lanky black goat-rabbit with bangs over one eye, one floppy ear, a leafy scarf with dangling vines, green arm bands and a long vine tail
entry: It hides its face behind its fur and keeps to the shadows, sulking. It only shows its single glaring eye when it springs out of the undergrowth to catch someone off guard.
how: Wild: rare in forests at night.
Evolves into Ghillope at level 36, learning Bramble Ambush.
